title: feat(nm2orilefz): signed leftover-axis det orientation of 1-in 2-out at t+1 on two-axis opposite z-probes: reverse HOLD, face fails
science: opposite z-probes, signed-leftover-axis det orientation. Orient=(-1,-1,-1,+1) at A,B,C,D: reverse holds, face fails because C and D swap the (m,pair) columns. The only reverse=HOLD this letter achieves anywhere in the band.
